title: No connection with Dana R after recent dev updates
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
Previous build was from 2025-10-05. Current is `d2921befb5-2025.10.16`, `3.3.3.0-dev-c`
After upgrading, there's no connection to Dana R. Logs attached from sequence of actions: remove logs; exit AAPS; additionally click on "bluetooth status" icon on pump tab to force connection; wait a while, save logs.
Logs:
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1760635290909.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22955647/AndroidAPS_LOG_1760635290909.log.zip)

Additionally, downgrading to previous build doesn't work, AAPS just shows blank screen, and apparently keeps restarting. I do not have logs of that.
